## Council preview

- first-session-friction — Generate changes from observed first-session failures.
- value-comprehension — Generate changes from comprehension evidence and user questions.
- recovery-path — Generate changes for users who stall or make an error.

Format: Nominal ideation — generate independently before group influence narrows the options.

Each real member uses distinct evidence. The coordinator will cluster duplicates, then evaluate the remaining options against impact and effort.
